title: Choose the look of KANDO (new set)
question: Nothing is built yet. These are all new directions. Pick one for the entry screens, Home, Search and the provider page, or ask for another set.

options.label: Die Wäscheleine
options.lineage: a washing line across a sunny back garden, pegs and linen on a bright morning
options.thesis: Every helper is a clean card pegged to one long line in the sun, and a free day is a peg with a small flag.
options.viewport: A pale sky, a line sagging across the screen with white helper cards hung by wooden pegs, a warm sun in the corner and one green button: Hilfe finden.
options.risk: Cards must stay stable and readable; if the sway and sag are overdone it looks like a toy and weakens trust.

options.label: Der Wochenmarkt
options.lineage: a German weekly market stall with striped awning, chalkboard prices and crates
options.thesis: Each kind of help is a stall under a striped awning, and the chalkboard says who is there today and what it costs.
options.viewport: A striped awning across the top, a chalkboard headline, three crate-shaped category tiles and a red stamp button.
options.risk: Stripes and chalk can get busy; prices and booking steps need a quiet, plain surface under the decoration.

options.label: Die Postkarte
options.lineage: holiday postcards with stamps, postmarks and a hand-written line
options.thesis: Every helper writes you a short card in their own words, and a booking is a card you send back.
options.viewport: A cream card with a perforated stamp showing the helper, a hand-written greeting, a wavy postmark and one coral button.
options.risk: Handwriting and stamps can feel nostalgic and slow; the search and filter screens must stay fast and plain.

options.label: Portrait plate
options.lineage: full-length studio portraits on a flat painted backdrop with a ruled caption
options.thesis: Each helper stands full-length against one flat colour, with their name and skills printed in a ruled caption.
options.viewport: A sun-yellow backdrop, one helper figure in blue, a ruled caption with name, skill and rating, and a thin frame.
options.case: Personal and trustworthy because it shows real people with dignity; weaker on clarity, because it needs a real portrait of every helper and a list view is slower to scan.
options.risk: It depends on good photos or drawings of every helper; without them the screen looks empty.

options.label: Stage page
options.case: Loses both: colliding type sizes read as shouting, not as an invitation.
options.kept: One voice per helper: a helper's own words in their own line.

options.label: Moon-shadow bazaar
options.case: Loses both: a night-time world is the opposite of sunny and hopeful.
options.kept: Stalls ranked down one lane, which suits a phone list.

options.label: Typewriter glyphs
options.case: Loses both: green on black is technical and cold, not personal.
options.kept: A strict grid that gives every screen the same rhythm.
